items.statement: The author-proposed torsional route has a high barrier in both environments.
items.expected: A validated approximately orthogonal TS lies about 1.43 eV above E in gas and 1.42 eV in implicit acetonitrile.

items.statement: The result implies thermal kinetic hindrance within the modeled ground-state scope.
items.expected: The approximately 137 kJ/mol barrier is interpreted as unlikely to be crossed spontaneously under ambient thermal conditions, without claiming an experimental rate or excited-state mechanism.
